citations.assessment: The local Yosef entry names Rabbi Abba as his son. Rav Kahana’s local roster records Rabbi Abba bar Yosef bar Rava. These support the name in the conjecture, with the conjecture itself still open.
The earlier Yosef entry preserves both Yannai and Nannai at its close. The local pointer supplies both forms but does not settle which name belongs here.

holds.reason: The local Rav Kahana dossier gives Abba, rather than the heading’s Yannai, alongside its later Rav Kahana. That does not establish the heading’s chronology. Retain the printed placement.
